title: Mahoyo Inspired Fighting Game
author: charles25strain
selftext: Mahoyo (Witch on the Holy knight) has always been one of my favorite works. So I just wanted to prototype a nier / stellarblade / souls like style game with it. (made in unity, with real toon shader) This is just a show off post / would love to hear some of your ideas if your familiar with the genre or mahoyo. Not really sure if I want to continue working on it or not as there is some other stuff I have been working on for a long time. 6 Years of experience doing solo Game Dev and many of the scene is a combination of handmade assets with a mixture of AI assets. All sounds in the clip are real sounds. Everything was prompted over a span of 2 days. Probably over 200-300 prompts since I break everything down into small tasks and try to not mix too many systems together. Game Dev experience of 6 years. The player model is not AI but I will not say how I acquired it either.. The taller Killer doll model comes from unity asset store. And so do some of the Shouwa style buildings in the arena. (some were generated, some not). The smaller enemy is completely AI generated with AI animations. In my accumulation of past projects, I have had AI research my stronger implementations / stronger systems and I tell the agent to use the same methodology / system design in my new works.

comments.author: maxneuds
comments.body:
I think building style is fine.

Animations are decent for a prototype. You see yourself that there is no feel of impact and also hitboxes are far to big. You don't touch anything and they fall.

Have you seen/tried Kimodo? I am currently looking into it for Humanoid animations, might be good. In the end for a game like that you need to spend time on enemy design, enemy placement and a lot of world design for the game to be interesting. A battle arena kinda survivor game with a type-moon style character and different spells one can dig into might actually also work - imho better than aiming for nier or souls as solo dev. I think your character at least goes into the direction of fitting into type moon style.
